title: phaseolus vulgaris var. fragarinus
intro: Phaseolus vulgaris var. fragarinus, commonly known as kidney bean, is a variety of the common bean plant that is widely cultivated and consumed. It is rich in nutrients and provides several health benefits, including lowering cholesterol levels, reducing inflammation, and aiding in the management of type 2 diabetes. The therapeutic actions of kidney bean include its ability to act as an antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antidiabetic agent, which can help to protect against oxidative stress and cell damage. The bioactive constituents of kidney bean include polyphenols, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its therapeutic properties and health benefits.
